reason: Every notice and deadline already lands in my class WhatsApp groups, usually before the official one, and I check those all day anyway. I might install it if the college forces it, but I'd stop opening it in a week and mute the alerts.
objection: Not another app on my phone. Someone always forwards the notice in the group, so why would I open a separate feed?
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed the notices straight into WhatsApp, or if professors stopped posting in the groups and only used this app, so I had no choice.
